name: top_processes
description: Show top 10 processes by CPU and RAM usage
task_prompt:
Write a Python script using psutil to:
  1. List TOP 10 processes by CPU% (name, pid, cpu%, ram MB, status)
  2. List TOP 10 processes by RAM (name, pid, ram MB, cpu%, status)
Wait 0.5s after calling cpu_percent(interval=None) to get accurate readings.
Skip AccessDenied processes. Print as two neat ASCII tables.
